HelpCleanupBody:
1. Open Preferences and enable the rule sets for your software.

2. Click Scan cleanup items. Select a rule on the left to inspect files and diagnostics on the right.

3. Check the items you want to process. Uncheck individual files you want to retain.

4. Click Review selected and inspect every action. Only Confirm and execute changes files. Deletion bypasses the Recycle Bin.
HelpArchiveBody:
Select a file cleanup item, then change Treatment to Archive and keep originals or Archive then remove originals. Set the archive location in Preferences.

Each rule/root gets a new destination. The full selected copy is verified before a move removes any original. Only matched, checked files are archived.

AI-authored Copy and Move rules can supply their own destinationRoot. Import them through the File menu, scan, and review as usual.
HelpChatBody:
1. Select an account
Choose the complete account folder containing databases and media. Discovery may find it automatically.

2. Back up original data
Close the source chat client. Create and verify the raw backup; originals remain untouched. Incremental backup reuses unchanged resources from earlier generations.

3. Database access
Obtain a key with the explicit capture flow, enter a retained key or load a key file. Keys must match the selected backup. Viewing, copying and exporting a verified key are explicit actions; keys are never saved automatically.

4. Export a reading copy
Choose verification and optional password protection. Password protection starts after export finalization. Resume continues an interrupted export of the same backup; Update reading copy merges a newer backup.

5. Read and search
Search the conversation or the entire open archive, open result context and return to results. Set messages per page, use page navigation or enable the minimap. Click avatars or the conversation title for available details.

6. Protection and limits
Reading passwords require at least eight characters and cannot be recovered. Scope can select conversations, types or message content. Prefer whole-page protection; strict selection takes longer and creates sanitized public pages. Partial protection leaves unselected content readable. Keep raw backups and independent copies.
HelpCommandsBody:
Enable Application cleanup commands in Preferences. These rules use reviewed recipes: dotnet nuget locals http-cache --clear, npm cache clean --force, python -m pip cache purge, and uv cache prune.

Scan previews the exact executable and arguments without running cleanup. Review displays the command and its full-cache scope. Per-file exclusions do not apply. Tool output, exit status, timeout, and cancellation are recorded locally.

Rules select a supported recipe; they cannot inject shell commands or arbitrary arguments. You must install the relevant tool first.
HelpTroubleshootingBody:
No files found: check enabled rule sets, retention, and diagnostics. Linked folders are skipped unless local rules explicitly name verified physical cache locations.

Tool unavailable: configure the tool executable in private data/settings.json under toolPaths, or install the tool on PATH.

Chat export incomplete: inspect export-report.json; preserve the raw backup. Formats and client key storage can change.

Local records and rules are available from File > Open local data. Do not publish that private directory.
HelpStorageBody:
Choose a drive or folder and click Analyze folder. Double-click a directory to drill down; Parent moves back within the scanned tree. Largest files shows the top 100 entries. Diagnostics lists skipped links and access errors.

Analysis does not delete files. Sizes are logical file lengths and can double-count hard links; sparse or compressed files can occupy less physical space. Use Cleanup and archive to review a rule-based operation.
FreedNotice: Logical file sizes. Native cleanup compares complete before/after scans. Unknown measurements are not counted. Copies release no source space. Negative changes mean the cache grew.
